visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a young man wearing a brown 'Filter017' cap and a teal, yellow, and red color-blocked jacket speaking directly to the camera. Large yellow captions with red borders dominate the center frame. The background is a simple neutral-toned interior wall. (2) The scene cuts between the man in the cap and another man in a black t-shirt sitting on a beige sofa. They engage in an animated discussion with frequent jump cuts and variety-show style text overlays appearing and disappearing rapidly. (3) A promotional montage follows, showcasing the 'SEVEN x SEVEN' resort hotel. Visuals include a rooftop jacuzzi overlooking a coastline, a modern indoor sauna, an outdoor pool illuminated in blue at night, and a breakfast buffet featuring croissants and waffles. (4) The focus shifts back to the men indoors, joined by a third man in a white hoodie who speaks with intense facial expressions. They discuss travel habits while sitting in a modern hotel room with wood flooring and minimalist furniture. (6) The final phase features the man in the white hoodie pointing to a map overlay showing a flight route from Taipei to Ishigaki. The video concludes with a text-heavy screen displaying a promo code and hotel details.
